info.name: Trialx - Portal Integration APIs - Full + Optional
info.description:
Portal Integration API Specification v0.2 - all 34 APIs on InsureMO tenant **trialx**.

Variant: **Full (Mandatory + Optional fields)**.

1. Import `Trialx.postman_environment.json`, select it, fill `username` / `password` (Machine User).
2. Any request auto-fetches a token (collection pre-request script). Or run *API-02 > Get Token*.
3. Run in order (Collection Runner / Newman): search APIs store the signed IDs used by the load APIs.
4. Each request has structure tests; a failing test names the broken part. Saved examples hold the spec samples and the responses observed on trialx.

See `STRUCTURE-CHECK.md` for which API structures are not working.

exec: // Auto-fetch a trialx token (API-02) when none is cached or it is about to expire.
const skip = pm.info.requestName === 'Get Token';
const token = pm.collectionVariables.get('access_token');
const exp = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('token_expires_at') || 0);
if (!skip && (!token || Date.now() > exp) && pm.environment.get('username')) {
pm.sendRequest({
url: pm.environment.get('baseUrl') + '/cas/get-token',
method: 'POST',
header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({
username: pm.environment.get('username'),
password: pm.environment.get('password'),
tenant_code: pm.environment.get('tenantCode') }) }
}, (err, res) => {
if (err) { console.error('get-token failed', err); return; }
const b = res.json();
if (b.access_token) {
pm.collectionVariables.set('access_token', b.access_token);
pm.collectionVariables.set('token_expires_at', Date.now() + (b.expire_in - 60) * 1000);
} else { console.error('get-token: ' + b.message); }
